newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Phatra Thanakit 10 bln yen FRN group.
newsitem.headline: Phatra Thanakit 10 bln yen FRN group.

text.p: A group has formed for Phatra Thanakit Public Co Ltd's 10 billion yen floating rate notes due December 2001, the joint lead managers said on Tuesday.
The five-year notes were issued at par to float at 80 basis points over the six-month Yen London Interbank Offered Rates.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 85 basis points.
Joint lead managers are IBJ Asia, with 5 billion yen, and International Finance Corp, with 1.5 billion yen.
Co-lead managers, with 1.0 billion yen each, are Nomura International (Hong Kong) and Toyo Trust Asia.
Co-managers, with 500 million yen each, are ING Barings, Jardine Fleming Jank and New Japan Securities International (HK).
Signing is set for December 16. The payment date is December 19.
